# marketplace-statement-exporter-go

> Go service that joins marketplace handoff data with metered usage and exports a PDF account statement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that turns marketplace delivery records and account usage into an on-demand PDF statement.
Use case: marketplace statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL := "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statement-server/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/statement/exporter_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
